up: Please provide a list of all approved drugs (molecules with max_phase = 4) where the drug's mechanism of action includes acting as an antagonist (action_type = 'ANTAGONIST'). For each such drug, display the drug's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and for each target it antagonizes, the target's ChEMBL ID (target_dictionary.chembl_id) and preferred name (target_dictionary.pref_name). Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid. Filter drug_mechanism.action_type = 'ANTAGONIST' and molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. Return distinct rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'ANTAGONIST';
